note: Cross-runtime parity corpus for the vault and sanitizer. The nonce is FIXED so token strings are comparable across runtimes; in production it is a random per-observation value, which is what makes tokens unforgeable. B-6 refusal behaviour is part of every case because a divergence there is a security divergence, not a cosmetic one.

cases.name: repeated-value-shares-one-token
cases.text: Aadhaar 999999990019 and again 999999990019 on the same record.
